Title: General Availability: Online migrations for Azure Database for MySQL instances

Body.Content:
The Azure Database Migration Service online migration for Azure Database for MySQL now allows you to migrate an instance of Azure Database for MySQL – Single Server, on-premises MySQL instance, or MySQL servers in other clouds to Azure Database for MySQL – Flexible Server. This new feature provides minimal downtime for your critical applications and limits the impact to service level availability.

Learn more.
